notes:
A new look: Apple's macOS design with Liquid Glass.

- The window has a glass sidebar (Today, Reminders, Routines, History and your calendars) with the window buttons inside it, and a toolbar with Pause and New Reminder.
- Today shows Donna's next question beside her face, with Mark as Done and Skip This One, then the rest of the day.
- Reminders: type a reminder in plain words and see what Donna understood before you add it; Today and Tomorrow lists; each reminder's ⋯ menu has Edit, Snooze, Skip This One, Make It a Routine and Delete.
- Settings now open in their own window (⌘,) with General, Donna, Notifications, Calendars and Updates.
- New Glass setting (Settings > Donna): from Solid to Clear, with a live preview. Reduce transparency in macOS keeps everything solid.
- Donna's bubble is real macOS glass, with Done and a Later menu (In 5 Minutes, In 10 Minutes, In 1 Hour, Skip Today).
- The menu bar menu shows Donna's face and what's next, the time of the next reminder sits next to her icon, and Pause Donna has a new For 1 Hour choice.
- Donna follows your Mac's light or dark appearance; the colour themes are retired.
